note: Single pin manifest for the Atlas SparkGLM FP4-Local release (2026-10-17). Source, install tree, engine, image and model identities are final. The release image qualified on a DGX Spark pair (Enntity/sparkglm results/2026-10-17-fp4local: prompt-logprob hash 25bc828eea3f, tools 21/21, ToolEvalBench 91) and serves in production with SPARKGLM_PROFILE=4x1m. nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local ships its MTP layer quantized, so the checkpoint is served as published: no converter and no overlay. The normal install path addresses image.reference, the immutable GHCR manifest digest. The tag is retained as source-build metadata (the first 12 characters of the git tree of install/ at the pinned revision) and as the local tag produced by an explicit --source-build; the install-tree label is a contents check. A tag or label alone is never the artifact identity.
